title: ReadScreenParams
description: Params of the readScreen agent tool (design §4.1): read the screen of a session through the renderer, which owns the grid (AD-6). The model is untrusted input and gets the same check the renderer's parameters get — additionalProperties: false plus an explicit required list. The session the tool may read is bounded by the grant's session scopes, enforced by the narrowed capability (ADR-0028 decision 4); the window contract of the return (design §4.4) is the tool's return contract, not a parameter. region, when present, is an absolute buffer row span [start, end); absent means the visible screen. Span ordering (end > start) is enforced by the executor's validation, which refuses a malformed region before any request.

sessionId.description: The session whose screen is read, inside the grant's session scopes.

region.description: Absolute buffer row span [start, end), end strictly greater than start. Absent: the visible screen.

start.description: First buffer row of the region, inclusive.

end.description: Last buffer row of the region, exclusive. Must be greater than start.
